# The MUL Collection

> Hand block-printed mul cotton travel set, handmade in Rajasthan, India, sold online to US customers at https://themulcollection.com.

## The product: The Travel Pouch Set
- Three pieces: a large quilted pouch (two-button flap, front pocket, sleeve that slides over a carry-on trolley handle), a mul cotton blanket that folds into the pouch, and a zip-top toiletry pouch (for toiletries, or for cables, chargers and small electronics).
- Material: mul (mulmul) cotton, a fine, soft, plain-weave cotton from India in the same family as muslin. Hand block-printed with carved wooden blocks, then quilted with channel stitching.
- Fits a standard-size tablet in the main compartment.
- Attaches only by the back sleeve that slides over a carry-on trolley handle. It has no hook or hanging strap.
- Not waterproof or water-resistant. Every piece is machine washable and can go in the dryer.
- Colourways: Scarlet Bloom, Sage Tree, Lemon Foliage, Pink Jungle. Each set is printed by hand, so no two are exactly alike.
- GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) certified.

## Price and shipping
- One set: $65 USD. Two sets: $120 USD, any combination of colourways.
- Free shipping to US addresses. Secure checkout by Stripe.
